scope: Online password verification performance; no capture-policy or UI-style changes
changes: Use an owned interactive wpa_cli channel on the exact runtime STA section
Use fresh increasing runtime network IDs, flush PMKSA and match successful STATUS to current ID and BSSID
End early only on native WRONG_KEY for the current attempt; other failures remain bounded and unconfirmed
Do not wait for DHCP to identify a successfully authenticated PSK
Keep UCI backup/restore and old route when native capabilities are unavailable before attempting a candidate
Preserve cancellation, pause boundaries and bounded credential-free diagnostics
Combine legacy credential writes into one fail-fast SSH command
Validate UTF-8 passphrase byte limits and hexadecimal raw PSKs
Re-resolve each target radio and reconfigure when its verified band changes
Parse native carriage-return and interrupted command-prefix redraws without relaxing real reply validation

tests.native_contract: Real upstream CLI pipes against a synthetic local UNIX daemon; wrong-key, fresh ID, completion without DHCP and process exit

limits: No user router or wireless hardware was operated.
Native tests prove CLI transport behavior, not every supported device or firmware build.
Debian shared-module syntax and native CLI verified; full desktop runtime acceptance not performed.
Source changes only; existing 1.0.43_alpha package does not include this optimization.
